long.title: How to Clean Silver Jewelry at Home (Don't Use Toothpaste)
long.description:
Dull, tarnished silver? In this step-by-step video you'll learn how to clean silver jewelry at home with three methods: gentle soap and water, a baking soda paste, and the aluminum foil and baking soda bath for heavy tarnish. We also explain which pieces to avoid, how to rinse, dry and polish silver, and how to store it so it stays bright for longer. Safe, simple and cheap. No special tools needed.

You'll need: mild dish soap and warm water, baking soda, aluminum foil, a soft toothbrush, a silver polishing cloth.
